text: We encountered a string of <highlight>Decimal ASCII codes</highlight>. This requires a three-step extraction process: converting decimals to characters, decoding the resulting <highlight>Base64</highlight> string, and finally reading the hidden plaintext message.

The input consists of space-separated decimal values. Using <highlight>awk</highlight> with the <highlight>printf "%c"</highlight> function, we iterate through each field to convert the numbers into their corresponding ASCII characters.

code:
# Converting Decimal to a Base64 String
echo "079 084 10..." | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) printf "%c", $i}'

text: The output from Step 1 is a Base64 string. We pipe this directly into <highlight>base64 -d</highlight> to reveal the final hidden message.

title: Analysis of the Technique
items: Decimal Identification: Numbers in the 032-126 range usually represent printable ASCII.
Pipeline Efficiency: Using pipes (|) allows for rapid testing of different decoding layers.
Automation: In a real scenario, CyberChef's 'Magic' tool can often automate this entire sequence.
